visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The screen is divided into three horizontal sections. The top section displays a static, high-quality portrait of a male video game character with long, flowing cyan hair and amber eyes, wearing a purple and gold outfit. The middle section shows high-intensity MOBA gameplay with various characters moving rapidly, casting spells involving bright particles, neon light effects, and health bars. The bottom section features a looped animation of a character's feet swimming through clear blue water with sunlight reflecting off the surface. (2) The gameplay transitions to a victory sequence. A large, ornate golden logo with the word 'VICTORY' appears in the center of the middle frame against a backdrop of the game map. Yellow text overlays appear at the bottom of the middle section. (3) The middle section changes to an MVP results screen. A stylized profile card for the player '5years' is shown with an 'MVP' badge and character artwork. The background is a mix of geometric shapes and the game map interface. (4) The split-screen format vanishes, replaced by a single video frame of a real person. A middle-aged man with a short, buzzed hairstyle and a round face, wearing a black traditional Chinese-style top, stands on a stage with a blurred library-themed background. He has an exaggerated expression of shock, his eyes wide and mouth open as he speaks into a microphone.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, energetic electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat starts immediately. The audio is layered with sharp, high-frequency sound effects representing game actions: metallic slashes, spell explosions, and coin jingles. A professional female announcer voice provides status updates like 'Double Kill' and 'Shut Down' with clear articulation. (2) A transient, crystalline 'ding' SFX marks a transition in the game state, followed by more rapid combat sounds including percussive impacts and wind-like whooshes. The BGM maintains its high energy and bright spectral weight throughout the montage. (3) The background music continues as UI interaction sounds—soft digital clicks and bell-like tones—become more prominent. The environmental noise floor is practically non-existent, indicating a clean studio-grade master mix. (4) The music and game SFX abruptly cut out, replaced by a high-arousal male vocal outburst shouting '我的天呐!' (Wo de tian na). The voice exhibits significant pitch variability and a sharp rising intonation contour, indicating intense surprise. This is followed by a short silence before the audio ends.
